## What's new in 3.5

### Account check
Every token you add is now checked with Steam **before** it's added — one sign-in, invisible to friends:
- **Token check** — if Steam rejects the token, you're asked whether to keep the account
- **CS2 stats** — Prime, CS2 level, Premier, Wingman, competitive cooldown and profile medals
- **Loadout** — copies the weapon picks from your CS2 config source account
- **Workshop** — clears the account's Workshop subscriptions

Each part can be turned off in **Settings → CS2 Account Check**. Refresh stats any time with right-click → **CS2 → Check account**, or the **Check all saved accounts** button. Accounts playing on another device still get their stats, without interrupting the game.

### On the cards
- Tooltip shows CS2 level, tier, **medals as icons** and when the account was last checked
- **Filter** by Non-Prime / Prime / Premier
- A **star** marks your CS2 config & loadout source account
- Permanent CS2 bans now show as a ban instead of a long cooldown
- A ring around the avatar shows accounts being checked

### Look & feel
- **Accent color** — pick a preset or any custom color
- **Display scaling** follows Windows on every monitor, so WareStore is sharp and correctly sized on mixed setups (e.g. 4K + 1440p)
- Compact right-click menu with **Copy** and **CS2** submenus
- App version next to the window title
- Soft fade at the bottom of scrolling lists
- The log panel updates live, with one line per account check

### Changed
- **Interface scale has been reset to 100%** — it now zooms on top of Windows' display scale, so set it again if you want WareStore bigger
- The window opens in its default spot once after updating
- **Override config** now copies the loadout too
- Remote Play is always disabled on login (setting removed)
- Removed **Fetch CS2 ranks on launch** — use **Check all saved accounts**
- Removed **Auto-disable Workshop maps on switch** — replaced by **Clear Workshop subscriptions** when a token is added
- Removed **Copy token** — use **Copy → Export token to clipboard**
- Account checks are spaced out; if Steam rate-limits your connection, WareStore stops and suggests waiting or using a VPN/proxy

### Fixes
- Accounts no longer appear online while being checked
- Deleting your CS2 config source account now clears the source setting
- Changes in the account list no longer re-fetch every account's status
- The window no longer opens off-screen after a monitor is unplugged or rearranged
